en.title: Rials Weaken as Dollar Strengthens
en.summary: The probability of USD being less than 1.5M Iranian rials by June 30 decreased by 5.5% to 22%. This movement was primarily driven by a stronger U.S. dollar, which rose to a one-year high on increased prospects of higher U.S. interest rates, as reported by WSJ.
drivers: Increased U.S. interest rate hike bets
Dollar reaches one-year high
Citi forecasts lower oil prices
en.why_matters: A weakening rial impacts Iran's import costs and inflation, affecting its economy and citizens amidst ongoing international sanctions.
en.bull_case: Iran's access to $6bn frozen funds could significantly strengthen the rial, pushing the USD below 1.5M.
en.bear_case: Continued U.S. interest rate hikes and lower oil prices will further weaken the rial against a strong dollar.

zh.title: 里亚尔走弱，美元走强
zh.summary: 美元兑伊朗里亚尔在6月30日低于150万里亚尔的概率下降了5.5%至22%。这主要是由于美元走强，WSJ报道称美元因美国加息预期上升而升至一年高点。
drivers: 美国加息预期上升
美元升至一年高点
花旗预测油价将走低
zh.why_matters: 里亚尔走弱将增加伊朗的进口成本和通货膨胀，在国际制裁下影响其经济和民生。
zh.bull_case: 伊朗获得60亿美元冻结资金，可能显著提振里亚尔，使美元低于150万。
zh.bear_case: 持续的美国加息和油价下跌将进一步削弱里亚尔兑强势美元。
